security.broker_credentials: systemd RAM-only credentials; no environment or image secrets
security.broker_transport: private Unix socket; scoped per-run capability; not mounted into native codec
security.inbound: deny except pinned-key admin SSH from approved source
security.outbound: broker-only approved Supabase DB/Storage and necessary infrastructure; parser denied

limits.job_retry_policy: retain existing leased/fenced attempts, max_attempts and backoff; no launch retry on ambiguous outcome

release.image_policy: verified linux/amd64 manifest + config + archive hashes; immutable Docker ID at execution
release.startup: disabled maintenance until host binding, synthetic isolation and admission tests pass
release.rollback: stop admission; drain or fence active leases; stop worker; restore prior signed release; preserve DB records
release.application_publish: separate existing regression, schema and Netlify rollback gates must pass

required_before_activation: Founder approves new recurring host cost and secure account access
Verify live provider quote and selected region capacity before creation
Bind operator-authenticated provider host ID, boot UUID and signed deployment inventory; reject any old Google VM binding
Adapt production broker entrypoint and admission configuration explicitly; do not bypass hardcoded identity restrictions
Seal exact source and newly verified image IDs; null values are stop conditions
Verify actual host Landlock ABI and restrictive seccomp plus adversarial denied operations
Pass native AMD64 codec, resource, credential, network, watchdog and cleanup tests
Keep original queued jobs, historical holds and unknown accounting liabilities unchanged
Reconcile new host admission/accounting explicitly; fail closed on unresolved authorization
Apply only reviewed target-specific additive SQL with verified rollback; no blanket claim_job privilege
Run one approved synthetic end-to-end acceptance before normal admission
authorization_note: Founder authorized deployment subject to mandatory security, production compatibility and rollback gates. Processing remains disabled pending those gates.
